name: Azazel
source:
An archangel with a sword.

He is the chief angel who protects the Heavenly Order, but he has a self-centered and negligent personality. He is overconfident and likes beautiful girls.

He's interested in the winner of the Royale, and is not interested in the information and battles of each participant.

[Translated from [url=https://warabimochipizzacha.wixsite.com/heavensroyale]official website[/url]]
